summary: Decodes Huffman-coded delta values with sign adjustment, incrementally modifying existing coefficient values over a position range, with rollback of modified entries on failure.

local_names.v27: rollback log of modified output positions

Main decode loop: while the current position does not exceed this+0x16C, take 8 bits (v12 = byte-cast of v46 >> (v8-8)) and index the Huffman table v4[18] (this+0x1DC) at table + 4*v12 + 212; if the table entry is nonzero consume it directly, otherwise fall back to the symbol decoder.
Call HuffmanArithmeticBitstreamSymbolDecoder for symbols not found in the direct table; a negative result jumps to the rollback path.
Split the decoded symbol into v14 = symbol >> 4 and v44 = symbol & 0xF; if v44 is zero the decode ends.
If v44 is neither 0 nor 1, record the invalid extra-bits error by writing 114 to the vtable slot at *a1+20 (this+0x0 vtable, obj+0x14) and invoke the error handler through *a1+4 (obj+0x4) with -1.

Consume one sign bit: v15 = v36 if the bit is set else v35, apply the signed delta to elements reached through dword_5AF778, and record each modified position (v27[v40+1] = dword_5AF778[v16]) plus write the delta value back through the table.

If v14 is not 15, compute v43 = 1 << v14, consume v14 more bits when available (v8 >= v14), and combine the read remainder into the next position (v43 += (v21-1) & (v46 >> v8)); if fewer than v14 bits remain, call sub_51A794 to refill first.
